bgm.name: FRLG City - Sevii 1 - One, Two, and Three Island (Sevii Islands)

parameters: \bLex: May I ask you to battle the both of us at the same time?
\bLex: My darling Nya, together we could win!
Set the partner event's Self Switch "A" on.
\bI think it was a good experience for Nya.
\rThe way I am now, I may have to hold off on Trainer Tower...
\rNya: I'm sorry, but may we battle in two-on-two style?
\rNya: I'll do my best so I won't drag down my mentor, Lex!
Set the partner event's Self Switch "A" on.
\rNya: I think I'm going to need much more seasoning and tutoring under Lex...
\r...So, Lex, please, may I stay with you like this?
\bYou look strong.\nLet me battle you, please!
\bThe way you battle has given me a lot of useful data.
\bIt doesn't matter if you happen to have the strongest Pokémon...
\bIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't know how to use them properly!
\bYou see them every so often, Trainers with awesome Pokémon who have no idea what to do.
\bBefore training Pokémon, Trainers themselves need to grow up.
\rI was given the best possible education to become this strong.
\rI don't want to lose to anyone!
\rFor some reason, I get furious over the slightest thing.
\bTraining by oneself is certainly not a bad thing.
\bBut it's also not bad to aim for the top with a partner.
\bEven Bruno...\nHe trained with a fellow by the name of Brawly before.
\rThose shoes you have are pretty snazzy.
\rYour mom bought those snazzy running shoes for you?
\bI work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!
\bFrom far out among the stars, our planet is just a drop of water.
\bBut we want to protect that drop of water for everyone.
